task.title: Prime the pump
task.shortdesc: Get the first stroke of air into the kite bladder.

context.p: Do this on sand, not on a boat deck, so the base can sit flat.

step.cmd: Stand the upright and lock the hose on the kite valve.
Hold the base with one foot and take three full strokes.
If the gauge is fitted, stop at the kite card pressure, not at the red mark on the pump.
